newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major pokes fun at Labour's Blair.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major pokes fun at Labour's Blair.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major poked fun at Tony Blair on Friday, taunting the Labour leader with avoiding the press like the plague -- or New Black Death.
Major, in good spirits at his daily election news conference, accused Blair's media handlers of throwing a "cordon sanitaire" around the Labour leader to spare him unwanted grillings.
"He's been kept away from you rough lot," said the prime minister, who himself managed to sidestep some awkward questions on his Conservative party's policy on Europe.
"They're keeping Mr Blair out of the way like he was the plague -- or New Black Death as no doubt they would call it,
"Well, all I would say to you lot is I recall the old cry -- bring out you dead!" he said to laughter. Blair has renamed his party "New Labour" after moving it to the centre of politics.

Major was in a confident mood after his success on what newspapers have dubbed "Wobbly Thursday", when the Conservatives managed to expose chinks in Labour's armour on issues including privatisation, tax and union rights.
"Jelly is stable compared to their campaign," Major claimed.
